Cada nível é um conjunto fixo de ajustes: Each level is a fixed set of the app's tweaks, and each level includes the previous one. Low: Low-risk Power and Gaming tweaks. Medium: + Low-risk GPU and Peripherals tweaks. High: every Low-risk tweak. Maximum: + Medium-risk tweaks (the same set as Boost) and asks for confirmation. Extreme: + aggressive High-risk tweaks chosen only for performance (they never turn off Windows protections), outside Boost and with double confirmation. Other High-risk tweaks are never part of a level. The current level is calculated by reading the real state of Windows. Applying a level creates a restore point first and does not undo tweaks that are already applied. Results depend on the hardware.
Só números medidos. Alguns ajustes só tê: Measured numbers only. Some tweaks only take effect after a restart; the boot time only changes on the next boot.
Ajustes de risco Baixo de Energia e Jogo: Low-risk Power and Gaming tweaks (power plan, Game Mode and priorities).
Nível Baixo + ajustes de risco Baixo de: Low level + Low-risk GPU and Peripherals tweaks (HAGS, Game DVR, mouse acceleration, keyboard).
Todos os ajustes de risco Baixo, incluin: Every Low-risk tweak, including Windows and Privacy.
Nível Alto + ajustes de risco Médio. É o: High level + Medium-risk tweaks. It is the same set as Boost and asks for confirmation.
Aplicar o nível {0}? Serão aplicados os: Apply the {0} level? The tweaks that are still missing will be applied ({1} in the level in total). A restore point is created first, and each tweak can be undone in the Restore tab. Applying a lower level does not undo tweaks that are already applied. Results depend on the hardware.
O nível Máximo inclui ajustes de risco M: The Maximum level includes Medium-risk tweaks (for example, Windows services and features). Do you confirm you want to continue?
